title: release: add artifact signing, provenance and release-manifests for private-installer CI
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR introduces end-to-end release automation improvements for the private-installer: reproducible build artifacts, SBOM generation, in-toto provenance attestations, and automated artifact signing with cosign. Motivation: customers deploying Redwood Private require verifiable, signed release artifacts and machine-readable release manifests for air-gapped and regulated environments. The change set: 1) CI workflow (.github/workflows/private-installer-release.yml) now produces signed tarballs and Helm packages and uploads a release-manifests.json alongside checksums and cosign signatures. 2) Added scripts/sign_artifacts.sh and ci/verify_signatures.sh for signing and verification logic using cosign + KMS-backed keys. 3) SBOM generation via syft for all published artifacts, and an in-toto provenance step that records builder identity, inputs, and commands. 4) Helm chart packaging tweaks (helm/private-installer/Chart.yaml, templates) to include provenance metadata and chart provenance files. 5) Terraform module updates (terraform/modules/release_bucket) to provision an immutable release bucket with strict IAM bindings and object lock for release manifests. 6) Rollback/upgrade metadata support: release-manifests.json contains upgrade/rollback metadata and previous-release checksums to support safer rollbacks by the installer. 7) Documentation and a quickstart (docs/release-signing.md) for operators on verifying signatures and provenance offline. Checklist: [x] CI builds artifacts reproducibly, [x] cosign signing integrated, [x] SBOM and provenance attached to manifests, [x] release-manifests schema validated in CI, [x] docs updated. Testing: CI integration runs in a gated pipeline using test keys; manual verification done with customer ops on staging. No functional changes to installer runtime; this is release/packaging and infra only.
